state.summary: Some users express excitement about renewing their Netflix subscriptions to watch various shows and movies. Several tweets describe relaxing at home alone or with partners while binge-watching content like South Park and The Walking Dead. A few individuals complain about technical issues such as the app not loading or finding that certain titles are missing from the library. Others mention sharing passwords with friends or family members, sometimes leading to conflicts over account access. One user notes that they prefer Netflix because it has no commercials compared to traditional television.
